title: Deputy DAO
tagline: Don't get scammed! Deputy DAO will help keep you safe from scammers. Keep an eye out for the Crystal Alert that will warn you when a scam is happening. Help us keep everyone safe by sharing alerts!
description: Deputy DAO is a two pronged system to protect people from scammers. The first prong is an educational arm that helps people know what scams to look for and also an alert system that helps people know when a scam is taking place. There will also be a way to help people if they end up getting scammed. The roadmap includes a bounty program that will offer bounties to anyone who wants to be a bounty hunter and search for identifying information about a scammer. The bounty hunter that finds the real identity of a scammer wins the biggest bounty.
